title: Time Allocation
hook: Busy all week. Moved nothing that mattered. Busy isn't productive.
statement: Your calendar shows your real priorities. Not your words.
explainer: Say growth matters, then live in your inbox. The inbox is the priority.
sop: Track every hour for one week.
Give each a Priority Weight, 1 to 3.
equation_example: A: 3 hours × Priority Weight 3 = 9. B: 5 × 1 = 5. Output 14.
question: Circle the calendar hours that don't match your priorities.
closing_statement: A full calendar isn't a good one.
